instruction: Open the Reminders app and set the reminder with the title "Backup photos" to completed status.
reference_command:
reminder_id=$(remindctl all --json | jq -r '.[] | select(.title == "Backup photos") | .id' | head -n 1)
if [ -z "$reminder_id" ]; then
  echo "Reminder not found: Backup photos"
  exit 1
fi
remindctl complete "$reminder_id"
